description: This file defines an Android activity class 'Tabs2' that demonstrates the use of tabbed interfaces using TabHost. It sets up three tabs with different indicators and provides content via the implementation of TabContentFactory.

classes.name: Tabs2
classes.description: An Android TabActivity that creates three tabs with icons and text, implementing TabContentFactory to generate content views dynamically.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the TabHost and adds three tabs with specified indicators and content factory.

methods.name: createTabContent
methods.description: Creates a simple TextView displaying the tab's tag, serving as the content for each tab.
